overview_description.description:
Roboto Games is a game developer studio building synchronous multiplayer action games that are designed to be super fun.

Founded by Curt Bererton and Mathilde Pignol, Roboto Games is a small scrappy studio made up of plucky game industry vets who, despite common wisdom, cannot stop making games in the San Francisco Bay Area.

In 2007 Roboto Games founded ZipZapPlay, a web and Facebook games company, which they sold to PopCap and then became a part of Electronic Arts in 2011.
